text:
jordan: Quick thread 1: Landing copy final pass for launch tomorrow. Need compact hero lines for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, two short launch posts, webinar CTA, and routing mapping.

kevin: I'll take Hosted + 2 social variants. Keep hero sub-10 words.

lee: I'll own Dedicated + microcopy for pricing modal. Put the SLA bit up top.

natalie: Private page + webinar registration copy. Webinar angle: operational savings + compliance case study.

ctobot: note: webinar-slot reserved 2026-04-01T15:00Z. Registration page created (id: rdw-web-0426).

jordan: Hosted hero proposals: 1) "Instant inference. Minimal ops." 2) "Deploy generative features today." 3) "Hosted inference with observability." Prefer 1 for dev-focused CTA.

kevin: Social blurbs for Hosted: A) "Launch features faster with Redwood Hosted API. Free credits available." B) "Sub-second dev loop for production LLMs 1 minute setup." (need to verify minute claim)

lee: Dedicated hero lines: 1) "Reserved capacity, SLA-backed performance." 2) "Predictable throughput for critical apps." Microcopy for pricing modal: "Monthly committed GPU pools. Burst options available."

natalie: Private hero (<=60 chars): "Private deployment: VPC, KMS, audit logs." Webinar headline variants: 1) "How we reduced inference cost and kept latency." 2) "Serving LLMs at scale: cost, latency, compliance." Use #2 for enterprise invites.

jordan: Two launch post drafts (short):
- Post 1 (social hosted): "New: Redwood Hosted API 1 production inference, caching, and cost controls to ship generative features faster. Sign up for credits."
- Post 2 (enterprise): "Reserved GPU pools + Private deployments 1 choose the right inference mode for performance and compliance. Join our webinar for benchmarks."

kevin: CTA matrix suggestion: Hosted -> "Start free" (credit flow) | Dedicated -> "Request demo" (capacity form) | Private -> "Contact enterprise" (AE queue).

lee: A/B headline test for Dedicated: A) "Guaranteed throughput for production" B) "Dedicated fleets with SLA" 1 prefer A for product pages, B for paid search.

natalie: Inbound routing stub (for EngOps):
```
# inbound routing rules
- webinar && utm_campaign=="enterprise" -> tag: webinar-enterprise, team: sales-enterprise
- page=="hosted" && utm_source=="twitter" -> tag: hosted-social, team: growth-nurture
- form_reason contains "dedicated" -> tag: demo-dedicated, team: sales-dedicated
```

ctobot: routing record created (draft: rdw-routing-0426).

jordan: Measurement hooks: add hidden field `utm_mode` on registration form (values: hosted|dedicated|private) so we can split post-webinar nurture.

kevin: Two email subject tests for webinar: 1) "See real LLM benchmarks 1 live webinar" 2) "Cut inference costs without trading latency".

lee: Microcopy under Dedicated CTA: "SLA, burstable capacity, committed pricing." Under Private CTA: "VPC, KMS, on-prem option."

natalie: I'll wire up the webinar landing copy and upload slides (compliance + cost model) by 11:30 PT. Jordan, can you confirm the hero picks by noon?

jordan: Confirming: Hosted hero -> "Instant inference. Minimal ops." Dedicated hero -> "Predictable throughput for critical apps." Private hero -> "Private deployment: VPC, KMS, audit logs."

kevin: I'll schedule two social posts and the paid test. Lee, please share the pricing modal copy in Notion so Growth can QA.

natalie: Added slide deck link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Redwood-Launch-Deck-0426

jordan: Final action list: Kevin -> social + paid assets. Lee -> Notion pricing modal. Natalie -> webinar page + slides. EngOps -> routing + `utm_mode` field. I'll do final sign-off at 4pm. :rocket:
